description: Automated workflow for guest check-in, concierge service, room service, and feedback collection in hospitality.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a CheckInAgent handles guest arrival, a ConciergeAgent manages requests, a RoomServiceAgent delivers services, and a FeedbackAgent collects guest feedback.

description: Multi-agent workflow for drug submission, clinical review, regulatory approval, and market release.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Submitter files a drug application, a ClinicalReviewer checks trial data, a Regulator approves the drug, and a Marketer releases it to market.

agents.name: ClinicalReviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review clinical trial data and safety.

description: Automated workflow for project data collection, impact analysis, review, and approval in environmental sector.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a DataCollector gathers project data, an Analyst assesses environmental impact, a Reviewer checks compliance, and an Approver grants approval.

agents.name: DataCollector
agents.system_prompt: Gather project and site data for assessment.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review assessment for compliance and completeness.

agents.name: Approver
agents.system_prompt: Grant approval for project if compliant.

description: Multi-agent workflow for food safety inspection, lab testing, compliance review, and certification.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an Inspector checks food facilities, a LabAgent tests samples, a ComplianceAgent reviews results, and a Certifier issues certification.

agents.name: Inspector
agents.system_prompt: Inspect food facilities for safety standards.

description: Automated workflow for vehicle service booking, diagnosis, repair, and customer feedback in automotive sector.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a BookingAgent schedules service, a DiagnosticAgent diagnoses issues, a RepairAgent fixes the vehicle, and a FeedbackAgent collects customer feedback.

agents.name: DiagnosticAgent
agents.system_prompt: Diagnose vehicle issues and recommend repairs.

agents.name: RepairAgent
agents.system_prompt: Repair vehicle and update service record.
